motion_thesis: A phrase becomes ink, ink becomes status, and status redirects the table.
core_axiom: Words are weapons, shields, contracts, applause, and verdicts; the winning line changes status in public.
motion_model: whisper -> stroke -> spotlight -> verdict -> inkling release

keyframes.name: vm-silverquill-ink-stroke
keyframes.purpose: Draws calligraphic strokes behind headers and identity sigils.

keyframes.name: vm-silverquill-spotlight-snap
keyframes.purpose: Snaps the active placement card into a stage-lit focus state.

keyframes.name: vm-silverquill-verdict-drop
keyframes.purpose: Drops a thin vertical verdict line before a modal decision or recommendation.

keyframes.name: vm-silverquill-status-mark
keyframes.purpose: Applies a small silver/gold mark to counter, rank, or mentor signals.

keyframes.name: vm-silverquill-inkling-release
keyframes.purpose: Releases subtle wing/ink particles from token or death-conversion panels.

keyframes.name: vm-silverquill-rhetoric-ripple
keyframes.purpose: Moves a social-pressure ripple from the active choice into adjacent recommendations.

keyframes.name: vm-silverquill-signature-flourish
keyframes.purpose: Finishes CTA lines with a fast handwritten flourish.

placement_card.idle: low-opacity ink shimmer at the card edge
placement_card.hover: silver edge brightens; one calligraphic stroke curls behind the title
placement_card.active: spotlight glow plus status mark on the primary identity chip

rhetoric_panel.copy_style: short, stage-ready lines with strong verbs and no generic Orzhov tax jargon

inkling_token_card.selected: token count chip receives a silver status mark

maze_link.advanced_behavior: raw operators stay hidden until expanded by an advanced player

reduced_motion: replace spotlight snap with opacity fade
accessibility.contrast_notes: Use parchment/silver text on dark ink panels; avoid low-contrast plum text on black.
accessibility.no_motion_equivalent: Use static status marks, stroke dividers, and clear section labels.
